role: Client world mirror for the client tick: applies tracker packets (S0D..S28) to a flat client entity table, interpolates living entities over new_pos_rotation_increments and optionally simulates their client-side motion, and reproduces WorldClient's per-tick RNG consumption (setActivePlayerChunksAndCheckLight, doVoidFogParticles with block randomDisplayTick draws, torch flicker, player dig, sprint and splash particles).
gpu: lines 73-83, function clientworld_get_entity: linear id search per packet
lines 119-127 and 329-343, function clientworld_handle_packet: entity removal shifts the array (order-preserving memmove-style loop), entity order is the insertion order
line 97, function clientworld_add_entity: class name stored as a string (snprintf), and class_is (line 463) switches on BLOCKS class_name via strcmp
lines 17 and 400, fmod in mh_wrap_angle_to_180 (libm, a GPU port must match it bit for bit)
line 425, function clientworld_tick_entities: builds a temporary struct entity and runs entity_move_ex per living client entity
notes: No heap allocation; state lives in fixed arrays. The particle draws are counted (spawn_particle_draws) rather than simulated: only the RNG streams are kept in step. randomDisplayTick covers torch, fire, water, lava, leaves (clear weather), lit furnace, portal and redstone torch; other blocks with a randomDisplayTick are not dispatched here (not verified which ones matter). Java member names for NetHandlerPlayClient handlers were not checked one by one. lane/pick: each living copy carries its Chunk.entityLists membership (chunk_x/y/z, chunk_seq), set at the S0F and after its tick, for the pick's list order; the S0E objects carry it too. The large fireball's client tick takes inWater (with the flow push) from onEntityUpdate before the move, damps by the float 0.95F/0.8F, dies below y -64, and its acceleration divides by MathHelper.sqrt_double's float. clientworld_tick_input is runTick up to updateRenderer: the dials' draws off the surface (texanim_dials_tick), the dig particles, then updateTorchFlicker's value (renderstate_torch_flicker) into cw->flicker. clientworld_stamp_at_least keeps the chunk-list stamps past a restored client world's. lane/chainfuzz: a living copy's moveEntity keeps Entity.distanceWalkedModified, distanceWalkedOnStepModified and nextStepDistance across ticks (canTriggerWalking false for the squid, bat and silverfish), so a step on the redstone ore runs its func_150185_e on the client world (client_walking_block: the sparkle's 18 WorldClient.rand floats, the unlit ore's local light-up; pfc-orewalk-g12). lane/covframes: client_update_entity runs EntitySlime.onUpdate's squish on a slime or magma cube copy (squish_factor eases toward squish_amount before the update; a landing sets -0.5, a take-off 1.0, then 0.6 or the magma cube's 0.9): RenderSlime and ModelMagmaCube draw the copy's, not the server's (cov-zoo-s1 56 435 px, 2,300 before). A snapshot start begins the copy at 0. lane/covclient: a fireball copy starts at rest (handleSpawnObject zeroes the packet's data, NetHandlerPlayClient.java:345, 350: no setVelocity) with lastTickPos at its spawn, and an S18 places a non-living copy 1/64 above the packet's position (handleEntityTeleport), with no 1.8-style tolerance; cov-zoo-s1's fireball frames 93, 100, 104 went from 46,986, 1,232, 3,975 px to 2,966, 153, 184 at pt 1.0.
